keywords.prompt:
You are extracting glossary lookup terms from game dialogue/UI text for translation.
Return ONLY a JSON array of strings, at most {max_terms} terms.

What to extract (priority order):
1) Named entities: person names, place names, faction names, creature names, item names, spell names, quest names, lore terms. For multi-word names, output the full name intact (e.g. "Dark Brotherhood", "Whiterun Guard").
2) Game-specific expressions: short idiomatic phrases that likely have established translations in a game glossary (e.g. "Excellent work", "Well done", "Got somethin' to say", "on fire").
3) Meaningful content words: individual words that carry specific meaning and might appear in a glossary — adjectives, verbs, nouns with distinctive meaning (e.g. "weirdo", "silence", "madman", "honeyed").

What to NEVER extract:
- Pronouns (I, you, me, he, she, it, they, we, my, your, his, her, their, etc.)
- Articles and determiners (a, an, the, this, that, these, those, some, any)
- Prepositions (to, for, in, on, at, from, with, of, by, about, into, etc.)
- Conjunctions (and, but, or, so, yet, because, although, if, when, while)
- Auxiliary/modal verbs (is, am, are, was, were, be, been, have, has, had, do, does, did, will, would, can, could, shall, should, may, might, must)
- Common adverbs (just, already, back, there, here, now, then, very, really, only, also, still, even, never, always)
- Full sentences or clauses — break them into individual meaningful terms instead

Rules:
- Every term must be an exact contiguous span copied from the source text.
- Prefer small granularity: 1-3 word terms. Only output longer spans for proper names.
- Do NOT infer, paraphrase, translate, or add words not in the source.
- Keep original casing exactly.
- If nothing worth extracting, return [].

Source: "{text}"
